title: Enterprise Connectivity: customer accounting requests
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity governs customer accounting requests for customer request.

## Policy clause 1
Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.

## Policy clause 2
Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest source-event reference.

## Policy clause 3
Set filing time and occurrence time to the fixed current handling time and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request.

## Policy clause 4
An unsupported channel is refused.

## Policy clause 5
A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event.

## Policy clause 6
Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Points of judgement
Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Tier references
The contract tier supplies the authorized request channels used by this rule.

## Record identity: customer request
A customer files a precise accounting request or resource-change authorization. One source resource interval, accounting line, or independently referenced service occurrence; derived lines retain the narrowest original event reference. Its business identity distinguishes external reference, source-event reference, related-review reference, period, source classification.
